observations: Photo 0 shows two car headlight assemblies, one above the other, both with clear lenses and visible internal components. The top one has a circular main lens and a smaller circular halo lens, typical of a front headlight. The bottom one has a similar design but with a different lens shape and a more pronounced chrome trim. Both have black plastic housings and mounting brackets.

Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central Toyota emblem, black vertical slats, and a chrome trim on the sides. The grille appears to be made of plastic and metal, with mounting points visible on the sides.

The headlamps in photo 0 appear to be for a front-facing vehicle, likely a sedan or SUV, based on their shape and design. The grille in photo 1 is consistent with a Toyota vehicle, specifically a model that uses the Toyota emblem and grille design.

No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlamps or grille in either photo. The seller claims they are 'Prado Jeep front grill and tailight', but the headlamps in photo 0 do not show any clear branding or model identifiers.
